verdicts.reason: A is at least laid out as a left-to-right banner with a legible headline and CTA, but it is badly overstuffed. The bullets are out of order and one is dropped (it starts with 'Fine bubbles'). The legal line sits at the top as a competing header, the logo pill shrinks to a speck, and the product disc is tiny. The bullet, tagline and legal text are too small to read. B just shrinks the whole portrait layout into a small block in the middle of the banner and leaves both sides empty, so every element, including the headline, CTA and logo, is unreadable.
